text:
jia: Heads-up — I'm planning to ship the new runtime-config UI that exposes per-route routing weights + soft quotas. Need platform + ops sign-off on rollout plan and telemetry we collect. Thoughts? :eyes:
leah: What's the API surface change? minor schema bump or a breaking rename? if it's just add fields we can be backwards-compatible.
omar: Prefer a schema bump with feature-flagged activation. We should avoid any in-place semantics change on route selection. Also how will this affect the routing cache?
sneh: From Console UX — we want a preview mode where operators can 'simulate' new weights without applying. Show expected traffic split numbers before apply. Default should be OFF for new customers.
leah: API idea: add an "activation_mode" enum: ["preview","canary","immediate"], plus an opt-in "shadow_routing":true flag. Example: ```POST /v1/runtime-configs/activate {"route_id":"/v1/generate","weights":{"blue":0.1,"green":0.9},"activation_mode":"canary","shadow_routing":true}```
jia: Good. For telemetry, I want to capture: applied_weights, shadow_hit_rate, token_cost_delta, latency_p50/p95, and a sampling rate for traces. How granular should sampling be? per-route? per-customer?
omar: Per-route + cohort sampling. If we sample all traces for canary customers we might overwhelm jaeger. Suggest adaptive sampling: 100% traces for first 1k requests during canary, then 1% afterwards. Also emit an event for each activation with an opaque activation_id.
sneh: Console needs activation_id so we can link the rollout card to dashboards. Also request a small read API to fetch preview simulations: `/v1/runtime-configs/preview?activation_id=...`.
leah: Ops concern: if the routing cache invalidates on apply, we could get a spike in cold-starts on some backends. Plan: soft apply that updates weights in-memory and drains old routes over 30s. Add a rollout window option `drain_seconds`.
omar: Also add a safety circuit: if token_cost_delta > +15% OR error_rate increase > 0.5% absolute within 5 min, auto-roll back. These thresholds should be configurable in the activation payload.
jia: I like auto-rollback, but need alerts wired to the console. Can we create a default dashboard tile that lights up during and after rollout? Suggested panels: "activation health" (error%, latency change, cost delta) and a sparkline for shadow_hit_rate.
leah: I'll wire telemetry events to `runtime.activation.*` metric namespace. We'll also add a structured log line: `activation_id=<id> route=<r> mode=<m> weights=...`.
sneh: UX: add a little toast with :rotating_light: when auto-rollback triggers and a direct "open runbook" link. Also show which users approved the activation (audit).
omar: One API nit: activation should be idempotent by activation_id. If activation_id repeats, return 200 + current status. Prevent double-applying.
deploy-bot: deploy finished: infra/runtime-configs@3.6.0 -> deploy-prod (sha: c3f9b2). :thumbsup:
jia: OK next steps: (1) leah implement metric names + structured log (2) omar implement adaptive sampler + rollback logic (3) sneh wire UI preview + activation card (4) i'll draft runbook + alert thresholds. Anyone want to own final sign-off?
leah: I can own the rollout runbook + infra changes. Will add a changelog note.
omar: I'll review the rollback sim and add unit tests for sampler.
sneh: Will mock the preview API and push a console PR.
jia: Thanks team — I'll post a short checklist in #release-notes when ready. If anything blocks, ping me. :thumbsup:
